mentions.name: Lemuroid Debug
mentions.description: A fork of the RetroArch emulator for Android that adds cheat support, including a built-in cheat database so users don't have to look up cheat codes manually.
mentions.problem: Players previously had to look up cheat codes manually.
mentions.source_excerpt: Lemuroid Debug is RetroArch emulator for Android forked with cheats. Someone added a built-in cheat database so you don't need to look up codes.
